notes.deenhindi-tirmidhi:2715: Both complete fields read: Zayd commanded to learn Jewish writing, quoted trust concern, completion before half-month, subsequent writing and reading letters. notes.deenhindi-tirmidhi:2717: Ibn Abbas relays Abu Sufyan's actual Syria traders/Heraclius summons/arrival/request/read-letter narrative and the actual supplied letter opening. Preserve original formula plus own translation as same report, actual recipient/title and source-rendered locale, no continuation invented beyond truncated amma-bad. notes.deenhindi-tirmidhi:2718: Anas finite report of intended letters, advice about unsealed letters, making ring and present recollection of hand/ring shine.
